recognize_zh: 雙格富細胞骨髓抹片，顆粒球與紅系前驅細胞都有，左下有一個大型巨核細胞；箭頭指出核形不規則或核質成熟不同步的前驅細胞。此 Wright 染色只能看出輕度異型性，環狀鐵粒母細胞必須靠鐵染色證實，本圖無法直接看出。
features: Two-panel composite of cellular bone marrow aspirate fields
Trilineage hematopoiesis with abundant granulocytic precursors at all stages
Erythroid precursors present, some with irregular nuclear contours or asynchronous maturation (arrows)
Large megakaryocyte in the left panel without obvious hypolobation at this resolution
No Prussian blue iron stain shown; ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows a cellular specimen with trilineage hematopoiesis, including granulocytic precursors at all stages, erythroid precursors and a large megakaryocyte. Arrows highlight precursor cells with irregular nuclear contours or asynchronous nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation, suggesting mild dysplasia, although resolution limits detailed assessment. Blasts are not obviously increased. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on this Romanowsky stain; a Prussian blue stain showing at least 15% ring sideroblasts (or at least 5% with SF3B1 mutation) is required for MDS with ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: A reactive marrow shows orderly maturation without persistent dysplasia or ring sideroblasts and lacks clonal abnormalities.
Congenital forms present early in life with microcytic ring sideroblasts and germline ALAS2 or related mutations rather than clonal SF3B1 mutation.
Separation depends on ring sideroblast percentage and SF3B1 status, which are not visible on this stain.
